::: {#rem-feature-matrix-usage}

#### Which matrix a "feature matrix" is

ESL writes "raw feature matrix" for the matrix of raw inputs [@hastie2009elements, Chap. 18],
and ISLR2 writes "training feature matrix" for the matrix of raw word indicators of a text data set [@james2021islr2e, Sec. 10.4].
Both are the input matrix defined above.

A matrix of constructed features, such as powers of an input, is a different matrix.
These notes call it the [design matrix](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-projections.html#def-design-matrix),
and keep *feature matrix* for the raw inputs.

:::
